title: GALACTIC RUSH V5 - capital ship sheet (Halo of Vashti fleet carrier, software rendering, quality high)

views.label: gameplay distance: from the racing line
views.js: () => { const it = __game.scene.course.fleet[0], t = __game.scene.race.track; let b = 0, bd = 1e18; for (let i = 0; i < t.N; i++) { const d = t.pos[i].distSq(it.pos); if (d < bd) { bd = d; b = i; } } const p = t.pos[b]; return { pos: [p.x, p.y + 6, p.z], at: [it.pos.x, it.pos.y, it.pos.z], fov: 72 }; }
